prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single flat 2D hotel reception ROOM BACKGROUND for production in a mobile game. The attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its bottom-floor charcoal lobby and friendly old social hotel-game look. Original art, no UI, no text, no people.
Canvas landscape 2048x768, aspect ratio 8:3, filling the image edge to edge.
STRICT STRAIGHT-ON FLAT FRONTAL ELEVATION, rectangular wall, NO side walls, NO perspective floor wedge, no isometric or 3D rendering. Heavy near-black frame approximately 2% of image height around all four outer edges. Large flat charcoal-gray wall with subtle large diamond pattern, narrow gold horizontal trim at 76% height. Cream floor as a flat horizontal band from 82% height down to 96%. Door front-on at far left: x 3%-15% width, top 27% height, bottom 87%; simple teal glass with a warm wooden frame. At x 62%-80% width and y 17%-43% height a small walnut wall key rack with six large gold key hooks. Small round cream clock at x 42% width y 20% height. Two simple warm cream wall lights at x 28% and 90% width, y 25% height. Keep the entire lower center and right EMPTY: receptionist and counter and furniture are separate game layers added by code. No desk, no plants, no elevator painted into this background.
Flat vector-like hand-drawn cartoon, smooth bold dark contours, simple large shapes, restrained gold accents, clean color areas, two-tone shading only, no texture noise, no realistic lighting, no glow or photography. All details extremely readable at small size.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE empty economy bedroom background plate for a 2D cartoon hotel game. The provided image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY; match its blue and pink bedrooms. New image fills frame edge-to-edge, 1536x1152, 4:3 landscape.
Flat straight-on FRONT elevation of a room: pastel sky-blue #9ACCEC rectangular wall, very thick charcoal outer frame, cream flat horizontal floor band occupying bottom 14%. Absolutely no side walls, ceiling wedge, floor perspective or isometric depth.
Simple small WHITE wall-mounted air conditioner centered near the top (x40%-65%, y8%-20%). Simple wooden room door at right (x70%-90%, y42%-86%), warm walnut color, small gold knob, straight frontal rectangle. One modest square window at left (x17%-41%, y23%-48%), cream frame, pale blue glass with a simple cloud. No curtains.
Keep the bottom center EMPTY for movable bed, bedside lamps and guests added as separate layers in code. NO bed, NO furniture, NO pictures, NO plants, NO characters, NO UI, NO text.
Exact social hotel-game aesthetic of the reference: bold dark smooth outline, friendly large simple shapes, cheerful clean pastel fills, one simple shadow tone. No photo texture, no roughness, no realistic lighting, no gradients, no realism or 3D.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single FRONT LAYER reception counter sprite for a 2D flat cartoon hotel game. The input is style reference, especially its bottom-floor walnut desk with a gold top.
Draw ONE front-facing wide low reception counter in isolation. Rectangular walnut brown front panel, two subtle large panel divisions, thick golden countertop, a tiny simple gold service bell on the RIGHT of the top, an open cream guestbook on the LEFT. Desk width about 2.2 times full height including bell/book. Strict straight frontal elevation, absolutely no visible side face or perspective. Bold charcoal outlines, clean simple flat colors, one dark shade on wood, two flat yellow/gold tones. Very readable at 120px wide. NO person, NO words, NO plants, NO backdrop, NO floor, NO cast shadow or glow. Entire sprite comfortably padded and uncropped.
Output a TRUE alpha-transparent PNG: completely empty transparent pixels around and beneath the counter, not a checkerboard or painted background. Landscape 1536x1024.

Remove the background from this reception desk. Keep only the wooden desk, golden top, bell and guestbook as an isolated PNG cutout with a fully transparent background. Preserve the artwork unchanged. Clean edges, no shadow outside the object.

A single simple economy hotel bed sprite, isolated on a transparent background, in the flat cute cartoon style of the reference bedrooms. Strict SIDE elevation with the head at the LEFT and foot at the RIGHT, no perspective side walls or 3D. Wide bed about twice as wide as tall. Low dark charcoal bed frame with tall rectangular headboard only at left, tiny feet, thick cream white mattress, one plump white pillow resting on the left, smooth pale sky-blue duvet with a white folded top near pillow. Bold clean near-black outlines and only one shadow tone per shape. Friendly big simple shapes, readable at 100px. No person, room, text, sparkles, floor or cast shadow. Entire bed uncropped with empty padding on all sides. Production 2D game cutout, not a photograph.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for an existing 2D side-view hotel game.
Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its friendly large-headed guests, tiny black dot eyes, dark chunky hair, bold charcoal outlines and pastel flat fills. Do not reproduce the screenshot or its UI.
Create ONE guest sprite pose atlas on a truly TRANSPARENT background. Original guest: cheerful young adult man, fluffy dark brown hair, pale warm skin, tiny dot eyes, blue short jacket over white shirt, navy trousers, dark shoes, small brown travel suitcase when standing/walking. Giant head about 55% of visible height, tiny compact body like the reference. Flat hand-drawn digital cartoon, clean smooth outline, at most 2 shading tones, no gradients, no realistic lighting, no 3D.
EXACT REGULAR GRID: 8 columns by 4 rows. Canvas 3072 wide x 2304 tall; each equal cell 384x576. No grid lines, labels, background, checkerboard, captions, extra objects. Each pose isolated and centered in its own cell with generous empty padding; ALL standing feet on same baseline at 95% cell height; same scale and identity. Face turned slightly to right for game travel. Never overlap neighbouring cells.
Row 1 left to right: 4 subtly different idle breathing poses with suitcase; blink eyes closed standing; 2 sitting poses without suitcase; startled standing.
Row 2: 8 consecutive distinct frames of a smooth right-facing walk cycle carrying suitcase, alternating left/right planted feet and passing poses; torso/head same size, no giant jumps.
Row 3: 3 sleeping poses lying horizontally, head at left and eyes closed, white pillow but NO bed/blanket; 4 happy poses waving/smiling; startled surprise pose.
Row 4: 4 mildly annoyed poses, crossed arms and small frown, suitcase next to feet; leave final 4 cells fully transparent.
Clean game-ready silhouette, coherent shape language matching reference. This is one animated character atlas, not a collage of different people.

Edit target: the supplied guest pose atlas. Preserve the exact character design, expressions, scale and pose arrangement. This is a sprite sheet for a game, not a rendered poster.
Required correction: remove the entire gray checkerboard completely and output a TRUE RGBA image with transparent alpha outside the artwork. Do not draw a checkerboard or colored background. No glow, no halo, no floor shadows; clean hard cartoon alpha silhouettes with only thin antialiased edges.
Also correct the walk row: the SAME brown suitcase must remain held in his left hand in EVERY one of the eight walk poses, including the passing poses currently missing it. Keep the consistent blue jacket, white shirt, navy trousers, dark shoes, brown hair and head size.
Remove floating Z letters, exclamation symbols and white anger puff. Keep all actual character poses, faces and pillow. Leave generous transparent space between every pose. Do not add any text, grid, frame, or new poses.

Remove the background from this entire sprite sheet. Keep ALL the character poses and their suitcases and pillows exactly as they are. Output a PNG with a completely transparent background between and around every character, clean edges. Preserve the arrangement and artwork.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for a 2D cartoon hotel game. The reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Create one full-body hotel RECEPTIONIST character, isolated cutout, TRUE alpha-transparent PNG background. Transparent means an actual alpha channel: do NOT draw checkerboard, gray backdrop, white rectangle, floor, shadow, grid or scenery.
Single standing character centered in a portrait canvas, facing three-quarter right, feet level, entire body uncropped with padding. Young adult woman, warm medium brown skin, oversized round head occupying 55% of the figure, chestnut bob hair, tiny black dot eyes, warm small smile, rosy cheeks, red pillbox hotel hat with narrow gold band, red uniform jacket, white collar and tiny gold buttons, dark skirt, small black shoes. One hand holds a large simple gold room key, other hand resting by side.
Precisely the reference's charming flat old social hotel-game cartoon style: bold near-black outlines, big smooth simple shapes, clean rich color, only one simple shade per shape. No realism, no 3D, no grain or text. Original design consistent with the reference. The output is a cutout sprite, not a poster.

Make a production animation pose sheet for ONE red-uniform hotel receptionist.
Reference 1 = the target game's flat cartoon style. Reference 2 = identity reference for the receptionist: preserve her chestnut bob, warm skin, red pillbox with gold band, red jacket with white collar and gold buttons, dark skirt and tiny dark shoes. Simplify her eyes to tiny black dots and shorten body so the head is 55-60% of figure height, like reference 1.
32 equal cells in a precise 8 COLUMN x 4 ROW layout, landscape 4:3 image. One isolated full-body pose per occupied cell, same size head and body throughout, align feet to same relative baseline in every cell. Space between poses. Flat bold charcoal outlines, simple flat color fills, no glow or gradients. Transparent background. No labels, lines or scenery.
ROW 1: four subtly different idle poses, a closed-eyes blink, three happy waving poses.
ROW 2: eight successive distinct right-facing walk-cycle poses, alternating planted feet and passing legs; arms swing naturally.
ROW 3: six work poses: retrieve key, raise key, reach out to hand key to guest, hold out key, draw hand back, return hand to side; then one happy pose and one startled pose. No counter in image.
ROW 4: four mildly annoyed poses, one startled pose, final three cells empty.
Key is a small gold key only in work poses. No text, exclamation marks or extra props. Each cell's character must fit completely inside its space. This is a coherent sprite pose atlas, not a poster.

Remove the background from this receptionist sprite sheet. Keep ALL 29 character poses, key props, arrangement, faces and uniforms exactly as they are. Output a PNG with a completely transparent background around and between every pose. Clean edges, no outside glow.

Create a production animation pose sheet for ONE hotel cleaner. Reference image is style only: flat friendly hotel-game cartoons, bold dark outlines, tiny dot eyes, oversized head about 58% of figure height, tiny body and shoes.
Original cleaner: young adult woman with medium warm skin, black bob hair and small white maid headband, pale blue uniform dress, white apron, tiny dark shoes. Consistent face/hair/clothes throughout. Carries a simple wooden-handled pale blue string mop for work; matching reference's cleaner without copying identity.
Precise 8 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS layout, 4:3 landscape canvas. Full figure centered in each equal cell, same size, feet on same relative baseline, padding between poses. Each figure and tool stays entirely inside its cell. Transparent background, no lines, labels, scenery, furniture or text. Flat simple colors, no realistic texture or glow.
ROW 1: four gentle idle poses with hands at sides, one closed-eye blink, three happy waving poses.
ROW 2: eight successive right-facing walk-cycle poses with alternating planted and passing feet, natural arm swing, no mop.
ROW 3: six work poses mopping a floor, mop bottom touches ground at the same level as feet, hands grip handle at all times, gentle back and forth strokes. Then one happy pose and one startled pose.
ROW 4: four mildly annoyed poses, one startled pose, leave last three cells empty.
One character, exactly 29 occupied cells. All drawing proportions match the reference's cartoon people.

Remove the background from this cleaner sprite sheet. Keep all the character poses, mop, faces and uniforms exactly as they are, in the same arrangement. Remove floating sweat symbols and the white anger puff as well. Output a PNG with a fully transparent background around and between every pose, with clean edges and no glow.
